title: Top 10 Online Part Time Jobs for Students in 2026
summary: Top 10 online part time jobs for students in 2026 - mobile and laptop options, daily payment picks, zero investment, and realistic earnings for each job.
body_markdown:
Online part time jobs for students have quietly become a standard part of college life in India - not because studies got cheaper, but because a phone and 1-3 flexible hours a day can now genuinely pay ₹3,000-₹25,000 a month. The catch is choosing well: the best part time jobs for students work around lectures and exams, need zero investment, and pay for output rather than fixed shifts.


This guide covers the 10 best[online jobs for students](https://gromo.in/blog/best-online-jobs-for-students-to-earn-money/) to work part time in 2026 - the latest, genuinely workable options. For each one you'll see the realistic monthly earning, whether it runs on **mobile or needs a laptop** , how fast it pays, and how to start. And one rule before the list: any "job" asking for a registration fee, deposit, or training charge is a scam - real online work from home without investment is always free to start. (For the online-only earning routes, see our guide to the[best ways to earn money online for students](https://gromo.in/blog/earn-money-online-for-students/) .)


## 1. Sell Financial Products with GroMo


**Earning: ₹5,000-₹25,000+/month | Device: mobile only | Payment: after each approved application**


The highest-paying option on this list, and one built for student life: no shifts, no targets, pause during exams - see how[students earn online with GroMo's zero investment business](https://gromo.in/blog/online-part-time-jobs-for-students-gro-mo-earnings/) . As a GroMo Partner you help people get financial products they already need - a friend's first savings account, a senior's first credit card, a demat account for a classmate who's started investing - from India's leading banks. The bank pays a commission on every approved application; a single credit card approval can pay ₹1,000-₹2,000+, more than most part time jobs pay for a week.


**How to start:**


1. Download the GroMo app and register free.
2. Complete the quick verification and free in-app training.
3. List 10 people on campus who need a financial product.
4. Share application links on WhatsApp and track approvals in the app.


## 2. Online Tutoring and Doubt-Solving


**Earning: ₹5,000-₹25,000/month (₹200-₹800/hour) | Device: mobile or laptop | Payment: weekly/monthly; per-answer on doubt platforms**


Teach juniors your strongest subject in evening batches on Zoom or WhatsApp, or answer questions on doubt-solving platforms like Chegg and Filo whenever you're free. Tutoring pays the best per hour of any student job, and doubt-solving is pure pay-per-output - log in for an hour between classes, earn, log out.


## 3. Content Writing (Now Supercharged by AI Tools)


**Earning: ₹4,000-₹25,000/month | Device: laptop preferred | Payment: per project**


Blogs, product descriptions, scripts, and social captions remain in constant demand - and students who use AI tools for research and drafts, then add human editing and originality, deliver faster than ever. Start at ₹1-₹2 per word on Internshala and Fiverr, build samples, and raise rates every ten projects. Strong English or a strong regional language both sell.


## 4. Video Editing for Reels and YouTube


**Earning: ₹5,000-₹30,000/month | Device: good phone works, laptop scales | Payment: per project**


Every creator and local business needs shorts, reels, and video edits - demand far exceeds editors who deliver on time. CapCut on a phone is enough to start; DaVinci Resolve on a laptop raises your ceiling. College fests, society pages, and campus creators are your first free portfolio pieces, then paying clients follow.


## 5. Social Media Management for Local Businesses


**Earning: ₹3,000-₹15,000 per client/month | Device: mobile capable, laptop helps | Payment: monthly retainer**


Salons, cafes, and coaching centres near campus need Instagram handled. Batch-create a week of posts on Sunday, then spend 30 minutes daily posting and replying. One client fits around any timetable; two or three make you the best-paid student in your circle.


## 6. AI Data Annotation and Model Training


**Earning: ₹3,000-₹15,000/month | Device: laptop mostly | Payment: per task/weekly**


The newest mainstream student job: AI companies pay remote workers to label images, rate chatbot answers, and verify translations - with Indian-language tasks paying a premium. Work is claimed per task, so it molds around classes perfectly. Apply to multiple platforms; intake opens in waves and accuracy unlocks better-paying queues.


## 7. Part-Time Virtual Assistant


**Earning: ₹6,000-₹15,000/month | Device: laptop | Payment: monthly**


Founders and busy professionals hire students for inbox management, scheduling, research, and follow-ups - 1-2 hour daily windows are common. It pays predictably, teaches professional communication, and looks excellent on a fresher resume. Find roles on LinkedIn, Indeed, and freelancing platforms.


## 8. Transcription and Subtitling


**Earning: ₹3,000-₹12,000/month | Device: laptop + headphones | Payment: per file/weekly**


Convert audio to text or add subtitles to videos - steady, quiet work that fits low-energy evening hours. Indian-language transcription pays more with less competition, and the OTT subtitle boom keeps demand growing. Accuracy is the whole skill.


## 9. Micro-Task, Survey and Earning Apps


**Earning: ₹500-₹5,000/month | Device: mobile only | Payment: often daily/instant to UPI**


The easiest start and the answer to "online part time jobs for students in mobile":[task apps](https://gromo.in/blog/complete-task-and-earn-money/) , survey panels like Google Opinion Rewards and PollPe, and cashback/refer-and-earn apps all run entirely on a phone and many pay out daily to UPI. Honest ceiling: pocket money. Use them in dead time while a bigger option from this list grows.


## 10. Campus Ambassador and Remote Internships


**Earning: ₹1,000-₹10,000/month + certificates | Device: mobile or laptop | Payment: monthly stipend**


Startups and ed-techs pay student ambassadors to represent them on campus, and remote micro-internships (marketing, research, operations) pay stipends for a few hours a week. The money is moderate; the resume value, network, and letters of recommendation are the real compounding return. Apply at semester start on Internshala and companies' career pages.


## How to Pick: Mobile vs Laptop, Hours, and Payment Speed


- **Only have a phone?** GroMo, doubt-solving, reels editing, social media management, and earning apps all run mobile-only.
- **Have a laptop?** Add writing, AI annotation, VA work, and transcription - the per-hour rates rise with a keyboard.
- **Only 1 hour a day?** Doubt-solving, surveys, and GroMo follow-ups fit; avoid retainer jobs that expect daily presence.
- **Have 2-3 hours?** Tutoring batches, social media clients, editing projects, and serious GroMo weeks all become possible.
- **Need money fast?** Survey/task apps pay daily; doubt-solving pays per answer; GroMo pays per approval. Retainers (VA, social media) pay monthly but predictably.


Run whichever you choose the student way: cap it at 10-12 hours a week, pause during exams without guilt, and give one job 90 days before judging it. Your degree remains the biggest income multiplier you own - a part time job should fund it, not fight it. If you want the option with the highest ceiling and zero fixed hours,[start with GroMo](https://gromo.in/?ref=gromo.in) and earn from the campus network you already have.


## FAQ: Online Part Time Jobs for Students


**Which online part time jobs for students work without investment?**


All ten in this guide are free to start: GroMo, tutoring, doubt-solving, content writing, video editing, social media management, AI annotation, VA work, transcription, and survey apps. A genuine online job never charges registration, kit, or training fees - any 'job' asking for money upfront is a scam, not an opportunity.


**Which online part time jobs for students pay daily?**


Survey and micro-task apps commonly pay daily or instantly to UPI, and doubt-solving platforms credit per answer. GroMo pays per approved application, freelance projects pay on delivery, and retainer roles like VA and social media management pay monthly. If daily cashflow matters, combine a task app for daily payouts with a higher-paying weekly or monthly option.


**Can I do online part time jobs for students on mobile only?**


Yes - GroMo, doubt-solving apps, reels editing with CapCut, social media management, and all survey/task apps run entirely on a smartphone. A laptop mainly helps for writing, transcription, AI annotation, and virtual assistant work, where typing speed lifts your effective hourly rate.


**Is there a 1 hour part time job online for students?**


Yes - pick pay-per-output work: answer doubts on Chegg-style platforms for an hour, complete surveys in dead time, or use one focused hour for GroMo follow-ups on WhatsApp. Avoid retainer roles at one hour a day; they expect more presence. With 2-3 hours, tutoring batches and client work also become realistic.


**Are there govt approved online part time jobs for students?**


Be careful with this phrase: the government does not run an approval system for private part time jobs, and scammers use 'govt approved' or 'govt registered' labels to look legitimate. What actually exists: jobs at platforms operating under Indian regulation (for example, financial distribution through RBI-regulated bank products on GroMo), government internship schemes and portals, and legitimate private platforms. Judge any job by the checklist above - free to join, verifiable company, clear payouts - not by a fake approval stamp.


**How much can a student earn from online part time work from home?**


With 1-3 flexible hours daily: survey and task apps pay Rs 500-5,000 monthly; skill-based work like tutoring, writing, editing, and AI annotation pays Rs 3,000-25,000; and GroMo partners helping their campus network with financial products earn Rs 5,000-25,000+ with no fixed hours. Most students start small and roughly triple their earnings by month three of consistency.


## Disclaimer


Nothing here is a guarantee of income. All earning figures are indicative estimates for part-time effort alongside studies; actual results depend on your skills, consistency, and demand, and platform rates and openings change over time. GroMo commissions are set by the partner banks and financial institutions, vary by product and campaign, and are paid only on approved applications - check the live commission in the GroMo app before relying on any figure. GroMo is available only to users aged 18 and above.


Everything above is general information, not career or financial advice. Third-party platform names are trademarks of their respective owners. No legitimate online job ever requires a registration fee, deposit, or OTP sharing.
